Docyt HpAI
Payments Suite
Bill pay, corporate cards, receivables, and vendor management, unified under one set of budget controls. With Docyt, every dollar out flows through a single governed system.
AP automation with approval workflows
Automate invoice capture and coding, then route each bill through the right approval workflow, so your team cuts manual AP work without losing control over who signs off on spend.
Corporate cards with live budgets
Draw corporate card spend directly from real-time budgets, giving managers instant visibility into spend as it happens and stopping overages before they hit the books.
ACH, check and card payments
Pay vendors by ACH, check, or card, all from one bill pay workflow, giving each vendor the payment method they prefer without juggling separate systems. Batch payments and pay on time, every time, so late fees never eat into your margin.
Vendor management and 1099 filing
Manage vendors and generate 1099s in one place. Docyt keeps vendor records organized year-round and automates 1099 filing at tax time, so nothing gets scrambled together in January.
Accounting Suite
Revenue reconciliation, continuous bank and card reconciliation, and an automated month-end close on Docyt's own ledger.
Daily revenue reconciliation by PMS and POS
Docyt automatically matches transaction data from both systems against bank deposits and merchant payouts every day, flagging any mismatch the moment it appears.
Merchant deposit and chargeback tracking
Whether you accept cash, American Express, Chase, Square, or other forms of payment, you can keep your merchant deposits in check. Docyt tracks each merchant processor account separately for more accurate reconciliation and virtually eliminates missing revenue.
Zero-day close with audit trail
Docyt keeps books continuously reconciled throughout the month so close happens the moment the period ends, not weeks later, with every transaction backed by a digitized, searchable document trail ready for audit.
Multi-entity and intercompany accounting
Docyt manages books for every legal entity in a portfolio while automatically reconciling intercompany transactions, giving owners and operators one consolidated financial picture alongside clean, standalone statements for each entity.
Business Intelligence Suite
Daily flash, USALI reporting, budgeting, forecasting and scenario planning built on reconciled actuals instead of exports.
Business intelligence & reporting
Get your whole portfolio in one report, every morning. Daily revenue and labor flash, standardized financial packages and owner reports, with drill-downs from portfolio to entity to transaction.
Budgeting and forecasting
Find out you're short on profit on the 15th, not the 30th. AI revenue forecasting from PMS, STR and on-the-books data, plus weekly GM commentary on where GOP is heading.
Labor & payroll
Catch overtime while you can still do something about it. Get a daily flash report on labor and payroll, covering overtime, cost per occupied unit, and labor as a percentage of revenue, by department and location.
Portfolio roll-ups and owner reports
Get a consolidated view across every property, plus polished owner reports, ready to export and send, so management companies can report portfolio performance without stitching numbers together by hand.
Integrations and Migration
Seamlessly connect Docyt with your Point of Sale (POS) or Business Management System and automatically pull in your revenue, customer, and transaction data. Docyt offers integrations with more than 500 tools.

Frequently asked questions
What is Docyt for hospitality? Docyt is an AI-powered accounting and business intelligence platform built for hotel owners, management companies, and multi-property hotel operators. It connects to your PMS, POS, business management systems, and bank feeds to automate daily revenue reconciliation, expense management, and bill pay, then delivers real-time, USALI-compliant financials and KPI dashboards (RevPAR, ADR, occupancy, labor cost per occupied room) so you can see how every property is performing today, not weeks after month-end.
Does Docyt integrate with hotel systems? Yes. Docyt integrates with leading PMS, POS, banks, payroll providers, and other hospitality systems to enable real-time data synchronization. It automatically pulls in revenue, customer and transaction data to support real-time accounting and reconciliation. Docyt connects with 300+ systems and over 25,000 financial institutions.
What tasks does Docyt automate? Docyt streamlines your financial back office with automated bookkeeping, real-time revenue reconciliation, expense management, bill pay, payroll insights, and comprehensive financial reporting.
Can Docyt manage multiple hotel properties? Yes. Docyt handles multi-entity structures natively, with intercompany settlements, consolidation, management fee accounting and USALI-compliant owner packages across a portfolio of any size.
Is my financial data secure? Docyt is SOC 2 Type II certified, with bank-grade encryption and granular, role-based permissions down to the property and module. Your data is never used to train a public model.

Privacy notice
Docyt's privacy notice describes how we collect, use, share, keep and protect personal information across docyt.com, the Docyt application and any AI assistant you connect to your Docyt account. The full notice below is maintained by Docyt legal.
Your data belongs to you. No one else.
Docyt AI Privacy Policy
Last Updated: October 26, 2026
Your Data, Your Rules
At Docyt, we believe privacy should be simple:
Your data belongs to you. We don’t own it. We process your business’s books on your behalf and on your instructions.
Delete it, and it’s gone. If you remove your data, we remove it from our servers on the timelines in How Long We Keep Your Data .
Private by default. Nothing you add is public unless you decide to share it.
We built Docyt to make accounting easier, not to snoop on your information. This notice covers docyt.com, the Docyt web and mobile applications, and any AI assistant (such as ChatGPT or Claude) that you choose to connect to your Docyt account.
What We Collect (and Where It Comes From)
Docyt is accounting software, so most of what we hold is your business’s financial information. We collect:
Account information : your name, email, phone number, profile picture, job title, the business or businesses you belong to, and your role in each.
Financial documents : invoices, bills, receipts, bank and credit card statements, payroll reports, contracts and the other files you upload or that your connected systems send us. We store the files plus basics like file name, size and the data we read from them.
Transactions and books data : bank and card transactions, balances, account identifiers (such as the last digits of an account or card), your chart of accounts, journal entries, categorizations, reconciliations, financial reports and the KPIs we calculate from them.
Information about people on your documents : the names, contact details, payment details and amounts of the vendors, customers and employees that appear in your books and files. We process this on your behalf as part of doing your accounting.
Data from systems you connect : property management systems (PMS), point-of-sale systems (POS), payroll providers, banks and card issuers, QuickBooks Online and other integrations you authorize. We pull only the data you allow each connection to share.
Billing information : your plan, invoices and payment status. Card and bank details used to pay Docyt are handled by our payment processor; we keep only a reference and the last digits.
Communications : support requests, emails, chat messages and, where you use it, the SMS verification codes described below.
Device and usage details : browser type, operating system, IP address, crash logs, and which pages and features you use, so we can fix problems fast and understand what is useful.
Location : approximate location from your IP address or Wi-Fi. Precise GPS location only if you give us permission.
Contacts : if you allow it, we use your device contacts to make sharing simpler.
This information comes from you and your team, from the systems you connect, from the accounting firm or Docyt staff who work on your books with your permission, and from your use of Docyt. We also use cookies , the tiny digital reminders that help us remember your preferences and improve your experience. See Types of cookies we use .
How We Use Your Data
Here’s how we put your data to work:
To do your books. We extract data from your documents, match and categorize transactions, reconcile accounts, post entries to your ledger, close your months and produce your financial reports and KPIs.
To run Docyt. To log you in, sync your connected systems, process payments you initiate and deliver the reports and tools you use every day.
To operate AI features. Our accounting automations use AI models to read documents, suggest categories and answer questions about your books, under the rules in AI and Your Data .
To serve a connected AI assistant. If you connect ChatGPT, Claude or another assistant, we return the data it requests on your behalf, as described in Connected AI Assistants .
To support you. To answer your questions and resolve issues.
To improve Docyt. To understand which features are most helpful, using anonymized usage data.
To keep Docyt secure. To verify identities, block fraud or abuse and investigate incidents.
To bill you and keep records. To invoice you and meet our legal, tax and accounting obligations.
To keep you informed. To send important updates, like product changes or account notices, and, if you opt in, marketing emails.
No hidden agenda. No surprise usage. We do not sell your information and we do not use your books data to advertise to you or anyone else.
AI and Your Data
Docyt uses Google Cloud Vertex AI (Gemini models) to power certain accounting automations. And here’s the key part:
Your data is never used to train AI models .
We’ve set it up for zero retention : no storing your requests or responses.
Everything is encrypted with customer-managed keys .
All AI calls are encrypted, and enterprise customers can choose private, extra-secure routing.
In short: you get AI power without giving up control of your information.
Connected AI Assistants
You can connect a third-party AI assistant, such as OpenAI’s ChatGPT or Anthropic’s Claude, to your Docyt account and ask it questions about your business. Connecting is optional and never required to use Docyt. You start the connection yourself, sign in to Docyt and approve it on a consent screen.
What a connected assistant can read. When you ask it a question, the assistant may request the following from Docyt on your behalf:
The businesses in your Docyt account.
Financial reports: profit and loss, balance sheet, cash flow and operating statements.
KPIs and metrics, such as occupancy, ADR and RevPAR for hospitality businesses.
Portfolio summaries across your businesses.
Transactions, including dates, amounts, categories, vendor or payee names and whether they are verified.
Bank statement status and coverage.
Your Docyt account credit balance.
The assistant can only see businesses your own Docyt account can already see, with the permissions you already have. It never receives your Docyt password, your online banking credentials or access to any business you have not been granted.
What Docyt receives from the assistant. When an assistant calls Docyt, Docyt receives the details of the request: the business, the date range, the report or metric, and any filters, such as a vendor name or an amount. We use these details only to answer that request. For security, we log each request with your user ID, the tool used, the assistant’s name, your IP address and your device type. We do not log the request details. We keep these logs for up to 24 months, as described under How Long We Keep Your Data .
The connection is read-only. Every tool Docyt exposes to a connected assistant reads data; none of them write. A connected assistant cannot create, edit, categorize, verify or delete a transaction, post a journal entry, move money, pay a bill, upload a document or change any setting in your account.
What the assistant provider receives. The data Docyt returns, and anything you type in that conversation, is received by the assistant’s provider: OpenAI for ChatGPT, Anthropic for Claude. That provider’s own privacy policy and your settings with them govern how long they keep the conversation and whether they use it to train their models. Docyt does not control and cannot change those practices, so review them before connecting. Remember that your books contain information about third parties, such as your vendors, customers and employees, and that information travels with your questions.
Disconnecting. You can disconnect an assistant at any time from the assistant’s connector settings or by asking us at privacy@docyt.com . Disconnecting revokes its access to Docyt immediately. It does not delete anything in your books, and it does not reach into the provider’s own record of past conversations, which you manage with that provider.
How We Keep Things Secure
We take security seriously (without overcomplicating it):
Sensitive documents and credentials are locked with AES-256 encryption .
Every connection uses TLS 1.2+ encryption .
Our team uses multi-factor authentication and role-based permissions.
Every access to your data is logged and reviewed.
We maintain SOC 2 Type II compliance , independent proof that our security practices meet strict standards.
Your data is encrypted on your device, in transit, and on our servers.
How Long We Keep Your Data
We keep personal information only as long as we need it for the purposes above. The periods below are our standard practice:
Data How long we keep it
Financial documents and books data While your business is active in Docyt. After you delete it or close your account, it is removed from active systems within 30 days and from backups within 90 days.
Account, billing and transaction records While your account is open, then as needed to meet legal, tax and accounting obligations, generally up to 7 years.
Support requests and communications Up to 3 years after the interaction.
Usage, device and log data Up to 24 months in identifiable form; longer once anonymized.
Anonymized and aggregated data Indefinitely. It no longer identifies you or your business.
We may keep information longer where the law requires it, where it is subject to a legal hold or where we need it to protect our rights. Data that a connected AI assistant received is held by that assistant’s provider under its own retention rules.
Your Rights and Choices
You’re in control the whole way. In Docyt you can:
Delete files anytime. They’ll be removed from Docyt servers on the timeline above.
Deactivate your account. Stops new activity but keeps your past records accessible.
Opt out of marketing emails. Click “unsubscribe” and you’re done.
Disconnect any AI assistant or integration you have connected.
You can also ask us to:
Access the personal information we hold about you and learn how we use and share it.
Correct information that is inaccurate.
Delete your personal information, subject to the retention periods above.
Receive a copy of your information in a portable format.
Opt out of targeted advertising, the sale of personal information and profiling that has legal or similarly significant effects. We do not sell personal information or use it for targeted advertising, and we honor the Global Privacy Control browser signal as an opt-out request.
Residents of California, Colorado, Connecticut, Texas, Virginia and other U.S. states with comprehensive privacy laws have these rights under their state law. We extend them to everyone whose information we hold directly. To exercise them, email privacy@docyt.com or contact us at the address below. We will verify your request, will not discriminate against you for making it and will respond within 45 days ; if we need more time we will tell you why and take up to 45 more. If we decline a request, you may appeal by replying to our response, and we will answer the appeal within 45 days. If you are not satisfied, you may contact your state attorney general.
If your information appears in a Docyt customer’s books , for example because you are their vendor, customer or employee, Docyt processes it on that business’s behalf. Please direct access, correction or deletion requests to that business; we will help it respond.
When We Share Data
We don’t sell your information. Ever. We share it only in these cases:
Service providers that work for us , under contracts that limit them to our instructions: cloud hosting and storage, AI model providers (see AI and Your Data ), payment processing, email and SMS delivery, customer support tooling, product analytics, error monitoring and security services.
People you authorize : your team members, your accountant or bookkeeping firm and anyone else you give access to your Docyt account.
Systems you connect : the PMS, POS, payroll, banking and accounting systems you link to Docyt, which receive the data needed to keep them in sync.
AI assistant providers you connect , such as OpenAI or Anthropic, which receive the data your assistant requests, as described in Connected AI Assistants .
Payment networks and banks when you use Docyt to pay a bill or receive a payment.
If the law requires it , or to respond to lawful requests from public authorities.
To stop fraud or security threats and protect the rights and safety of Docyt, our customers and others.
If Docyt merges with or is acquired by another company. We will tell you before your information becomes subject to a different privacy notice.
In anonymized or aggregated form for research or product improvements.
SMS Communications and Mobile Data
Docyt may send SMS (Short Message Service) text messages to the phone number you have provided in connection with your account. These messages are strictly transactional in nature and are used exclusively to relay bank verification codes during Docyt’s automated bank statement retrieval process, in cases where your financial institution requires two-factor authentication. No mobile information will be shared with third parties or affiliates for marketing or promotional purposes at any time. Mobile opt-in data and consent are not shared with any third parties. Phone numbers collected for the purpose of SMS verification are used solely for that verification purpose. Docyt does not use your mobile phone number for marketing communications, does not sell your phone number to data brokers, and does not share your phone number with lead generators or any other third party for commercial purposes. Standard message and data rates charged by your mobile carrier may apply to messages you receive from Docyt. For information about how to opt out of SMS messages, how to request assistance, or how to resubscribe after opting out, please refer to the “Docyt Bank Verification SMS Program” section of our Terms of Service .
Who Can Use Docyt
Right now, Docyt is available in the U.S. only. If you’re outside the U.S., your data may still be processed here under U.S. laws.
Children’s Information
Docyt is not intended for individuals under 18, and we do not knowingly collect personal information from anyone under 18. If you become aware that a minor has provided us with personal information, please contact us immediately and we will delete it.
Types of cookies we use
Necessary : keep you signed in, remember your consent choices and protect the site. Always on.
Functional : remember preferences such as language and form details.
Analytics : help us understand how visitors use docyt.com (for example Google Analytics and HubSpot).
Advertisement : measure the ads that bring visitors to docyt.com and show relevant ads elsewhere. Off until you accept them.
Manage cookie preferences
You can modify your cookie settings anytime by clicking the ‘Consent Preferences’ button on docyt.com. This will allow you to revisit the cookie consent banner and update your preferences or withdraw your consent immediately. Additionally, different browsers offer various methods to block and delete cookies used by websites. You can adjust your browser settings to block or delete cookies. Below are links to support documents on how to manage and delete cookies in major web browsers.
Chrome: support.google.com/accounts/answer/32050
Safari: support.apple.com/guide/safari/sfri11471/mac
Firefox: support.mozilla.org/en-US/kb/clear-cookies-and-site-data-firefox
Microsoft Edge: support.microsoft.com/microsoft-edge/delete-cookies-in-microsoft-edge
If you are using a different web browser, please refer to its official support documentation.
Policy Updates
If we make changes, we’ll update this page and the date at the top. Big updates? We’ll give you a heads-up by email or in the app.
Contact Us
Questions or concerns? privacy@docyt.com

Docyt AI-native ERP
Answers to common questions about Docyt’s AI-native ERP, including AI bookkeeping, QuickBooks sync, integrations, security, pricing, and onboarding, for businesses in any industry.

1 Platform & AI 11 questions
What is Docyt? An AI-Native ERP handling accounting, payments, and business intelligence in one platform. Docyt automates day-to-day accounting, including categorization, reconciliation, and real-time financial reporting, for hotels, CFOs, and hotel management companies.
How does transaction categorization work? Docyt AI ingests bank/credit card feeds and documents, then auto-categorizes and matches transactions to supporting documents. Docyt can get to 99% categorization accuracy and near-100% document-to-transaction matching.
What happens when the AI can't confidently categorize something? When Docyt’s AI isn’t confident about how to categorize a transaction, it doesn’t guess. It flags the transaction for human review instead of auto-approving it. Your accountant or bookkeeper confirms or corrects the category before anything posts to your books, so uncertain entries never slip through unchecked. You get the speed of automated bookkeeping with a person still approving the judgment calls.
Does Docyt replace my bookkeeper or accountant? No. Docyt doesn’t replace your accountant or bookkeeper; it automates the repetitive accounting work that eats up their day. Built for accounting firms and finance teams, Docyt’s AI categorizes transactions, matches receipts and invoices, and reconciles bank, credit card and payment processor accounts automatically. That keeps back-office overhead from rising as you add clients or entities, and gives your team time back for strategic work like financial analysis, forecasting and client advisory. Judgment calls and financial decisions always stay with your team.
What is Docyt HpAI? The branded AI layer (“High Precision Accounting Intelligence”), stated to be trained on 128B+ accounting data points across 20+ industries.
What exactly triggers anomaly detection? In Docyt , anomaly detection is triggered by transaction outliers, system mismatches, or sudden deviations from established accounting baselines
What happens if I dispute a transaction categorization? Our team will review it.
What are the benefits of using AI in bookkeeping? Per Docyt’s own framing: fewer manual-entry hours (up to 80% cut, per Accountant Copilot messaging), faster close (5x), real-time rather than after-the-month visibility, and anomaly detection that catches errors before they compound.
What are the key features of an AI-powered accounting platform? Automated categorization and reconciliation, receipt/document capture and matching, bill pay and expense management, real-time financial reporting, anomaly detection, multi-entity consolidation, and (for firms) a unified client dashboard with white-labeled collaboration tools.
Can small businesses use AI accounting software like Docyt? Yes. Docyt’s AI accounting software helps small businesses automate time-consuming bookkeeping tasks like categorizing transactions, reconciling bank and credit card accounts, and managing expenses. Instead of waiting until month-end to see where things stand, owners get real-time financials and clear insight into cash flow and profitability. Docyt connects with the tools small businesses already use, so it’s easy to get started without an accounting background, and it scales with you as you add locations or grow your team.
Can I integrate AI-powered accounting software with my existing systems? 25,000+ bank integrations, 40+ POS/PMS systems, 200+ payroll/labor systems, and major GL/ERP platforms, including QuickBooks, Sage, NetSuite.
2 Security & data 9 questions
Is Docyt cloud-based? Yes, web app plus iOS/Android mobile apps.
Is my data encrypted? Yes, stated encryption at rest and in transit, including browser/phone-to-server and server-to-partner (e.g., QuickBooks).
Is Docyt SOC 2 compliant? Yes, SOC 2 Type II stated.
What happens if I lose my phone (2FA device)? Recovery goes through your carrier; the decryption key for a new device only releases after correct PIN entry, so a hijacked number alone doesn’t grant data access.
Can I export my data if I leave Docyt? Yes
Is there an audit trail for every transaction? Yes, Docyt generates a comprehensive, immutable audit trail for every transaction and financial workflow. The platform is designed to maintain audit-grade accuracy, meaning every action is fully traceable
Can multiple people log in with different permissions? Yes, multiple people can log in with different permissions in Docyt .
Is there an audit log for who changed what? Yes. Docyt maintains an automatic and comprehensive audit trail that records every modification made within the platform
What's the data retention policy after cancellation? 7 years
3 Integrations 3 questions
What does Docyt integrate with? 25,000+ bank integrations, 40+ POS/PMS systems, 200+ payroll/labor systems, and major GL/ERP platforms, including QuickBooks, Sage, NetSuite.
Does Docyt sync two-way with QuickBooks, or just export? Docyt features a full two-way (bidirectional) sync with QuickBooks Online.
It does not just push data one-way. Docyt’s artificial intelligence continuously monitors both systems and automatically pushes edits, category changes, and document-matching updates back into QuickBooks. If you change a transaction’s category, fix a vendor address, or re-code a document within Docyt, the system instantly updates the corresponding record in QuickBooks Online
Does Docyt support QuickBooks Desktop, or only QuickBooks Online? Docyt supports Quickbooks online. Docyt can help with migration from Quickbooks Desktop.
4 Features & reporting 14 questions
How does expense management work in Docyt for hotels? Docyt brings bill pay, vendor payments, credit card reconciliation, expense reports, receipts and employee reimbursements into one automated workflow for hospitality finance teams. Receipts and invoices come in by email, upload, scan or phone photo. Docyt’s AI reads each document, categorizes the expense and links it to the matching transaction. Your team then approves bills, pays vendors and reconciles credit card statements in the same place, across every property. Every document is stored in a searchable vault, so you’re always audit-ready.
Can employees submit receipts from their phone? Yes. With the Docyt mobile app, employees can easily snap a photo of a receipt and upload it for expense tracking or reimbursement in seconds. Then, Docyt’s AI reviews, auto-categorizes the expense, and routes it for approval.
What reports does Docyt generate? Real-time P&L, balance sheet, cash flow, and customizable dashboards; depth varies by industry vertical.
How real-time is "real-time" same-day, or lagged? Real time is literally in seconds.
Does Docyt have a mobile app for iOS and Android? Yes. The Docyt mobile app is available on iOS and Android, so business owners, accountants and finance teams can manage accounting tasks from anywhere. Snap and upload receipts, track expenses, approve and pay vendors, view financial reports and chat with your team in the app. Everything syncs with your Docyt account, so your books stay up to date on mobile and desktop.
Does Docyt support multi-entity businesses? Yes, each entity gets its own books plus consolidated reporting; each entity needs its own subscription.
Does Docyt support multi-currency? No
What accounting method does core Docyt use cash or accrual? Both cash and accrual
How does Docyt handle 1099 vendor tracking? Docyt automates 1099 tracking and tax reporting by combining AI-driven data extraction with centralized vendor management. The platform reduces year-end stress by handling W-9 collection, document storage, and 1099 generation directly within its ecosystem
Can I set a custom chart of accounts? Yes
Does Docyt support budgeting/forecasting, or only historical reporting? Yes for hotels.
How does approval routing work for bill pay? Approval routing in Docyt works by automating invoice intake and guiding them through configurable, roles-based approval workflows. It eliminates manual paper-chasing by routing bills to the appropriate staff members for review, approval, and payment based on your company’s specific spending policies
Does Docyt support ACH payments natively? Yes, referenced directly for accounting-firm vendor payments.
Can Docyt cut physical checks? Yes
5 Setup & support 7 questions
Can I migrate historical/backlogged books into Docyt? Yes, catch-up bookkeeping is an explicit use case.
What's the onboarding timeline for a new customer? We can onboard within a week depending on the size of the company.
What's the support model - phone, email, chat? Phone and email support confirmed (877 number, support@docyt.com ); basic chat/email support stated as included on all pricing plans.

Does Docyt offer implementation/professional services, or self-serve setup? Yes, we offer both support for setup and also self-serve depending on the scale of your business
Is training included, or a paid add-on? Included

Is pricing per entity or per user? Per entity/location.
Is there a transaction volume cap per plan tier? No

Can I get a free trial of Docyt's accounting software? Docyt offers a free, personalized demo built around your accounting workflows.

1 Getting started 4 questions
How does Docyt work for hotels? It is the AI Accounting Software for Hotels. Docyt automates revenue & forecasting, expenses, and labor reports. Hotels can see their profits in real time. Docyt supports multi-property hotels and all management companies.
Is hospitality onboarding different/longer than regular onboarding? Not listed as a stand-alone public timeline on-site, but set-up involves custom PMS mapping, chart-of-accounts tailoring, multi-entity configurations, which typically dictate a consultative onboarding track.
How long does it take to onboard a 5-property hotel group specifically? There’s no generic timeline published, as onboarding varies by specific system audits, API testing, and custom chart-of-accounts alignment.
Are vacation rentals treated differently than traditional hotels by Docyt? There are no special features for short-term vacation rentals; the platform’s features, frameworks (USALI), and marketing parameters are strictly focused on standard hotel properties, resorts, and franchises.
2 Hotel metrics & KPIs 10 questions
What is RevPAR? [GEN] Revenue Per Available Room = total room revenue / total available rooms. Combines occupancy and rate performance.
What is ADR and how is it different from RevPAR? Average Daily Rate= room revenue ÷ rooms sold (not available). ADR is only pricing power, RevPAR is pricing power and occupancy. Rising ADR, falling RevPAR = You’re pricing your way into empty rooms.
How does Docyt calculate Cost per Occupied Room (CPOR)? Standard definition: labour cost per occupied room night.
What is the GOP and does Docyt report it? Yes, Docyt tracks and reports on GOP. Docyt AI platform provides real-time, continuous tracking of the financials, so hotel owners and general managers can see month-to-date and year-to-date GOP versus budgets. Tools such as the Docyt Operators Report and Docyt Budgeting & Forecasting dashboard include real-time Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) for GOP, GOPPAR (Gross Operating Profit per Available Room) and TRevPAR
Does Docyt calculate cost per occupied room at the department level (not just labor)? Docyt produces real-time USALI financial statements that track departmental expenses but does not explicitly market specific granular non-labor CPOR mathematical metrics as out-of-the-box widgets.
Is Occupancy % tracked directly by Docyt? Occupancy is used as an input for automated RevPAR and ADR metrics surfaced on live hospitality dashboards, capturing the data directly via the PMS integration.
What is TrevPAR? Total Revenue Per Available Room – This includes F&B, spa, parking and other non-room revenue. Docyt aggregates all the ancillary POS streams and PMS room revenue into one USALI ledger, thus providing the critical financial information to feed total revenue metrics.
Does Docyt offer STR benchmarking comparisons? Yes, Docyt offers STR benchmarking comparisons. The platform integrates directly with Smith Travel Research (STR) to provide comprehensive competitive benchmarking and reporting for hospitality clients
Does Docyt have the ability to calculate the GOP flow-through ratio? Docyt leverages the industry standard USALI 11th Edition reporting structure, which means it can natively produce the Gross Operating Profit (GOP) line items needed to evaluate operational flow-through.
Does Docyt break out RevPAR by day part (F&B breakfast vs. dinner)? No. Docyt scores overall property hospitality KPIs (ADR, RevPAR); day-part meal segmentation is isolated within your specific property POS reporting layer.
3 USALI & reporting 7 questions
Does Docyt support USALI Reporting? Yes, Docyt has strong USALI (Uniform System of Accounts for the Lodging Industry) reporting support. The platform uses the USALI 11th Edition framework to generate live financial statements, custom charts of accounts, and automated profit and loss (P&L) reports for the hospitality industry.
What does USALI stand for? Uniform System of Accounts for the Lodging Industry the hotel standardized chart-of-accounts/reporting framework for property-to-property and benchmark (STR) comparability.
Does Docyt support daily P&L snapshots or only monthly? The focus of daily visibility is the “Daily Flash Revenue Report” which deals with daily revenue and labor metrics. A complete P&L can be generated dynamically “in seconds,” but a finalized compliant P&L depends on matching lagging monthly overhead expenses.
Can Docyt do brand-standard reporting templates (Marriott, Hilton, etc.)? Yes, in a roundabout way. Docyt’s hospitality engine is built natively on the Uniform System of Accounts for the Lodging Industry (USALI) framework, which is the underlying structural standard required by major hotel brands.
How often do you report the Daily Flash Report, literally daily? Yes, you will see the financial performance of all your properties daily.
Does Docyt automatically benchmark against the same period of the prior year? Yes. Standard historical period comparison (YoY and MoM) is supported by underlying reporting structures to identify regular variances.
Can GMs have a simplified dashboard rather than the full owner/accounting view? Yes. Docyt has a unique “General Manager Engagement Workflow” with specific user role restrictions that provide concise, operational updates and daily flash reports but does not display the corporate books at the highest level.
4 Labor & budgets 7 questions
Can Docyt catch labor overspend before payroll posts? Yes, Docyt is able to flag labor overspend before payroll posting. The Docyt AI platform is built with continuous daily labor tracking and business intelligence KPIs that compare your actual labor costs and hours to your daily budgets in real-time
Does Docyt support department-level budget vs. actual for other than labor? Yes. Docyt can track budgets and forecasts with real-time operational revenue/expense data and multi-department variance analysis in its reporting suite.
How is labor scheduling data getting into Docyt - API or manual upload? It flows through API. Docyt uses direct time-clocking and payroll integrations (like Paychex Flex) to automatically pull and sync workforce, hours, and labor metrics in real time.
Can I do seasonal budget adjustments in Docyt? Yes. Its budgeting and forecasting module provides standard temporal and seasonal updates across financial reporting cycles.
Can Docyt integrate with labor-management systems like HotSchedules? Docyt does support labor reporting and payroll insights, its primary time and attendance integration partners are platforms like Deputy and Paychex Flex
How does Docyt manage tip/gratuity accounting? Tips are reconciled by pulling continuous POS transaction logs and matching those against actual payroll provider data runs to check for accurate distributions.
Does Docyt automatically calculate labor cost as % of revenue? Yeah. With the combination of real-time revenue streams (PMS/POS) and synchronized payroll data feeds, the system natively tracks real-time trends in labor costs against active property earnings.
5 PMS & integrations 3 questions
What PMS systems integrate with Docyt? Docyt integrates with leading hotel property management systems, including Oracle OPERA, and connects with Sabre SynXis. With 30+ PMS and POS integrations and 300+ business system integrations, Docyt syncs revenue data automatically for accurate reconciliation and reporting. See all Docyt integrations →
What if a PMS integration breaks? Docyt’s underlying AI architecture features continuous anomaly detection and error checking that automatically flags out-of-balance files and provides instant discrepancy alerts to managers.
Does Docyt reconcile against channel manager data (not only PMS)? Docyt compares actual processor receipts to daily automated PMS and OTA data, reconciling cross-system data.
6 Revenue & reconciliation 8 questions
How does Docyt match PMS revenue vs bank deposits? Continuing reconciliation to identify revenue leakage prior to month end.
Does Docyt report merchant/credit card fees separately from room revenue? Yes. Docyt has built-in tools called “Merchant Processor Reconciliation” and “Merchant Deposit Tracking” to separate out and match credit card fees and processor deposits from the general ledger.
How does Docyt manage revenue for a F&B operation at a hotel property? Docyt connects directly to the property’s PMS and to separate POS systems. It self-contains multi-revenue streams that automatically pulls F&B transaction data directly to the respective food and beverage GL codes for categorization and matching.
How does OTA commission tracking work in Docyt? Docyt automates daily PMS and OTA transaction reconciliation. It reconciles gross reservations on incoming bank and merchant deposits to isolate netting differences and find revenue leaks.
What about resort fees / ancillary income? Docyt breaks out multi-revenue streams across any integrated property system, breaking down room revenue, resort fees and ancillary categories into separate ledger codes based on your configuration.
Does Docyt keep track of chargebacks individually? Chargebacks are within Docyt’s anomaly detection and merchant deposit tracking workflows that mark missing or mismatched processor deposits for manual operational review.
How does Docyt handle advance booking deposits? Docyt does basic tracking through normal accounts receivable (AR) tools and ledger entries, but advanced customized deferred-revenue rules need to be configured based on the underlying core accounting ledger (e.g., QuickBooks).
Does Docyt track complimentary rooms separately? This is handled directly by the PMS data translation layer for comp room mapping and tracks non-revenue occupancy data in addition to regular paid bookings.
7 Multi-property & owners 6 questions
Does Docyt support multi-property multi-brand accounting? Yes – Centralized ops with per entity and consolidated reporting. Each property billed separately.
What is the AP process for a group with multiple properties? Centralized AP with approval routing, vendor management and 1099 tracking. We scan, auto-categorize and code invoices to the GL using AI-driven OCR. The platform also natively supports automated transactions and settlement between entities across properties.
Can property A be benchmarked against property B side by side by ownership groups? Yes, Docyt live portfolio dashboards explicitly support side-by-side performance comparisons across multiple corporate business units and hotel entities.
Does Docyt have the ability to automate franchise royalty calculations? Multi-entity franchise accounting is a big marketing emphasis, but there are no specific automated, specialized royalty fee calculators listed, and the fees are typically handled through regular automated AP vendor routines.
Does Docyt automate management fee accounting for management companies? The primary target segment for Docyt is management companies. Generalized inter-entity workflow automation, bill payment loops and automated cross-location expense management address fee calculations.
Can owners view real-time cash position of a portfolio? Yes. Docyt cash deposit tracking and real-time portfolio BI tools are designed to meet the unique needs of cash deposits that are reflected in active bank feeds and merchant processors across an entire asset group.
8 Accounting & close 4 questions
How does month-end close differ with Docyt? It is a monthly close cycle but greatly accelerated. Docyt’s automated engine allows a full month-end close in as little as 15 to 45 minutes, depending on the size of the hotel portfolio, and provides live reporting visibility throughout the month.
How does Docyt distinguish between capex and opex for renovations? Docyt does this via custom general ledger (GL) mapping rules and OCR invoice coding settings. The user tells it which accounts are capital assets and which are regular operating expenses when they set it up.
Does Docyt track key money or PIP reserve accounting? Yes, Docyt tracks specialized hospitality accounting metrics, including franchise-level or property-level revenue streams and specific expenditures.
How does Docyt distribute utility costs among departments? Utility allocation is done using custom journal entries and pre-defined departmental allocation rules that you set up in your base general ledger settings.
9 AI accounting & comparisons 9 questions
What makes it hard for hotels to maintain daily bookkeeping automation? Hotels often rely on multiple disconnected systems and limited accounting resources. Manual data entry, delayed reconciliations, and fragmented financial information can make daily bookkeeping difficult.
